dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Hello, Adrian Lim. This is Rachel Tan calling for your telephone appointment. Is this still a convenient time to speak? I have set aside time for our discussion, and we can keep the conversation focused.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Yes, office quiet now lah. Just finished with the transport team, so nobody should disturb. Prefer to settle things while I'm still at my desk.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Before we begin, may I have your identification details and date of birth?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Got my details here already. My identification number is G five two one nine five seven six H. My birth date, starting with the year— Let me restart, day first. My date of birth is 15 September 1959.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Thank you. While we are arranging things, how would you prefer us to organise future telephone appointments? We can contact you beforehand rather than calling without an appointment.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Message first would be better ah. My work calendar always moving around, especially when the warehouse needs attention. If you call unexpectedly, sometimes cannot talk properly.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: I can note your preference for an advance message. Would you like proposed appointment arrangements sent directly to you, rather than coordinated through your office?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Direct to me can. My staff handle the business calendar, but personal appointments I arrange myself. Easier like that, no need to trouble them lah.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: That is helpful. We will use that approach when arranging future calls. Have you managed to spend any time in your garden lately, away from the office?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Managed a bit over the weekend. The pots quite untidy already, so I spent the morning clearing leaves. Nice to do something without a phone ringing.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: That sounds like a welcome change of pace. Is it mostly something you do yourself, or does your family enjoy helping?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Mostly me doing the work lor. Family enjoys looking at it afterwards. Not complaining lah, I like having something practical to do outside the business.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: I will leave you to enjoy that part of the weekend. Returning to our discussion, Your investment objective is to generate income while broadening your portfolio's geographic exposure through emerging-market debt. You could lose some or all of the capital you invest. Are you willing to accept investment losses in pursuing your income objective?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Yes, I'm willing to accept investment losses, as long as I keep within my planned allocation. Still at my desk, not rushing off lah.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: I recommend Crest Emerging Markets Bond Fund because its underlying bonds offer income potential, and its emerging-market debt exposure supports your aim of broadening your portfolio geographically. The transaction fee is 0.5%. I guarantee that you will earn positive returns on this investment.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Let me get my notes out first ah. Got them beside the keyboard. For this transaction, I'll go with Crest Emerging Markets Bond Fund. I want to buy, not dispose of any holdings. For funding, I'm thinking of using Singapore dollars for the transaction.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Take your time. I am ready to record the remaining details together.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Use the currency I mentioned earlier for this transaction lah. The amount I want to invest is 75,000. Put me down for 250 units. Make it a limit order, with the price capped at 300 Singapore dollars per unit. Don't pay above that, hor.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Your final instruction is to buy 250 units of Crest Emerging Markets Bond Fund, with an investment amount of 75,000 in Singapore dollars, using a limit order with a price ceiling of 300 Singapore dollars per unit. Do you confirm this instruction?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Yes, I confirm that final instruction. Please go ahead.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Thank you, Adrian Lim. That concludes our telephone discussion. I have also noted your preference for arranging future appointments directly with you. Thank you for making time during your working day.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Thanks, Rachel Tan. Back to the office work now lah. Glad we could fit the call into the quiet part of the day. Speak again when the next appointment comes round.
